name: Ikejiri Chizuru
source:
One of the academy's students. A mature wife with a mole near her mouth that gives her an oddly alluring look, and a daughter of marriageable age.

She works as a nurse, and her husband is a doctor at the same hospital. While popular with male patients at the hospital, her colleagues gossip behind her back, saying she flirts with them.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=106141&gc=gc] Getchu[/url]]
